environment.load_client_location: same process, separate asyncio loop, real loopback TCP

data.scale: bounded synthetic small world; not 100k-event medium design

load.cache_boundary: process query-result cache cold/warm; PostgreSQL and OS caches are not flushed
load.shared_conflict_policy: one predetermined TEST_FIXTURE control command before stale deliveries; not resource arbitration by database arrival order

metrics.latency_warning: P99 for individual write categories has few samples; descriptive only

database_application.pool_status_at_end: Pool size: 8  Connections in pool: 5 Current Overflow: -3 Current Checked out connections: 0

database_observer.stats_note: pg_stat_database cumulative counters may lag; application SQL and pool counters are separately measured by SQLAlchemy listeners

external_model.note: No real or fixture model dispatch; this measures service behavior, not model concurrency

limitations: One API process with eight pooled DB connections
No sustained capacity or multi-hour soak claim
HTTP pipeline represents control commands; joint scheduler arbitration is validated separately
